responsibility: This file implements the GIMPLE pass that lowers eligible GCC functions into the internal HSA IL representation. It performs HSA-specific preprocessing such as builtin expansion and switch conversion, builds hsa_function_representation objects from SSA GIMPLE, verifies arguments and kernel properties, emits HSA module-level variables, generates HSA instructions and symbols for the function body, triggers HSA register allocation, and finally hands the result to BRIG emission. It defines the hsagen gimple_opt_pass and is the main translation stage from GCC middle-end IR to HSA IL.
